instructions_to_main_agent: Build 'Bust a Lead' single-player Cutthroat Pinochle in React using pure Tailwind CSS, Lucide React icons, and Web Audio API.
Ensure game state (bankrolls, game phase, settings, stats) persists in localStorage.
Implement full Cutthroat Pinochle logic: 48-card deck (double A, 10, K, Q, J, 9), 15 cards per player + 3 kitty cards.
Bidding phase: minimum bid 250 (or configurable 200-300), 10-point increments, pass option.
Kitty & Discard phase: Bid winner picks up 3-card kitty, declares trump, declares marriages if any, and discards 5 cards before meld phase.

Meld evaluation phase: evaluate A-Run (150), Royal Marriage (40), Common Marriage (20), Dix (10), 100 Aces (100), 80 Kings (80), 60 Queens (60), 40 Jacks (40), Pinochle (40), Double Pinochle (300). Defender Aces declaration panel included.
Trick phase (25 tricks or 15 tricks depending on Pinochle deck rules, 15 tricks for 48 card deck 15 cards each): strict lead-following and trumping rules. Highlights legal playable cards.
Bust a Lead alert: Trigger dramatic neon modal/sound when a player fails to follow suit when holding led suit, or fails to beat high card when required (Cutthroat Pinochle rule violation).
Settlement phase: animated math breakdown showing Bid vs Meld + Trick counters, multiplier applied, and bankrolls transfer.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='bid-btn', data-testid='card-spades-ace', data-testid='sound-toggle').
Provide a Rulebook & Meld Reference Modal and Pre-game Settings Modal (Bid base, Sort order, Speed, Audio toggle).
